input.quote: Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination fee is payable by Customer anywhere; convenience termination carries no charge (9.4), force-majeure termination is "without penalty" (27.3), and Section 7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately not due. The Section 2.1 shortfall exposure is addressed under MINCOMMIT rather than double-counted here.
